_meta.title: Olive Pizza — Menu Structural Metadata
_meta.description: IMPORTANT: Actual products, prices, coupons, and availability are pulled LIVE from Firestore. This file only contains static structural metadata (crust types, sizes, toppings schema). Do NOT hardcode product prices or names here.

dietary_policy.description: Olive Pizza is a 100% Pure Vegetarian restaurant. We do NOT serve any Non-Veg food — no Chicken, no Mutton, no Eggs, no Seafood of any kind.
